text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Well then. Are you ready, Trainer?
Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To bring our "Formula for Victory" that much closer to perfection...
we must continually adjust, revise, and refine our theory!

...Biwa Hayahide decided to enter the Sprout Memorial.
She accepted the race as Narita Brian's substitute.

Expectations for Narita Brian's debut had been sky-high.
...Inevitably, there were a few disappointed murmurs of, "Oh, it's just the older sister?"
Even so, Biwa Hayahide stood tall and dignified.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...To be frank, a part of me is simply putting on a brave face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, I have people by my side... people who believe
in the proof of my theories, and the completion of my "Formula for Victory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I want to be the kind of big sister who can at least keep a promise to her little sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me. Trainer, if all this brainpower
is making you hungry, please don't hesitate to say so.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I actually started simmering a batch of curry last night.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Finely chopped vegetables stewed until completely melted...
It's packed with nutrients, subtle enough even for a notoriously picky eater to enjoy.

And so, over bowls of her special curry,
Biwa Hayahide and I spent day after day refining our theories. Until at last—

The day of the Sprout Memorial arrived.
Beneath clear blue skies, a large crowd had gathered at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer.
...Weather and wind speed are well within optimal parameters.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I have brought myself to peak condition.
However...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let us conduct one final tactical briefing... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, regarding today's opposition, the intel is complete.
There are two horsegirls of particular note—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Through Passport, who made a name for herself on the regional circuit, favors front-running.
Across twelve mock races so far, she has led from the front in every single one.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then there is Titan Frying Pan, whose transfer to the Central league is confirmed.
There is a high probability she will deploy a late-charging strategy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Prudent, with formidable mental fortitude... Much like Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perfect? ...Haha, quite the bold statement!
One could almost call it carefree.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Though I suppose your unhesitating confidence in such moments
is precisely what keeps me anchored.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then—it is time. Shall we?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...Brian. Are you watching this race from somewhere out there?)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Alright!
Let's pick up the pace, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
So cooool...! Me too, me too!
I'm gonna catch up to ya, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Or have you already moved so far ahead of me
that I no longer register in your field of vision?)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...No. For now, even that is fine.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will show you... I will make you remember.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The back of the older sister you once chased...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Under perfectly clear skies, the Sprout Memorial gets underway!
What kind of performance will these ten horsegirls of the next generation deliver today?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Good. The start was optimal...!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's this?! The front-runner Through Passport
is dropping back rapidly! What on earth happened?!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's substitute, Biwa Hayahide, is pushed into the lead!
Meanwhile, the promising Titan Frying Pan holds a great position in the rear!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will prove the validity of my methods with results...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My weapon is this theory...!
My "Formula for Victory"!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, approaching the final corner, Titan Frying Pan makes her move!
She's sweeping around on the outside!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't let you overtake me here...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! Biwa Hayahide pulls away!
After setting the pace the entire race, she still has this much left in the tank?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll make you—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Chase after my back once again!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide leaves the competition in the dust! She breaks away!
What terrifying, merciless speed!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide! It's Biwa Hayahide!
Remember the name of this next-generation star: Biwa Hayahide!!!
(WAAAAAAHHHHHH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
First place.
...Hmph, an expected outcome.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —She is my big sis, after all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOH!! BI-WA-HA-YA-HI-DE!!
That was soooooo amazing, Taishiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, you're loud... Why are you talking to me?
...I'm leaving.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Whoa whoa whoa, where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...To train, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...GASP!!!!! You got all fired up!
Watching Hayahide!! Didn't you, Taishiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Me tooooooooo!!!!
Let's train, train, traaaaaaain!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's not—! Hey!
Stop following me!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well... we have secured a successful outcome.
choice_data_list: That brings us one step closer to completing the "Formula for Victory."
That brings us one step closer to completing the "Formula for Victory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Indeed.
Which means the real journey has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yet one day—without fail.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Come, let us return and begin our post-race analysis, Trainer!

—And so began our days of striving alongside
Biwa Hayahide toward the completion of the "Formula for Victory"!
